svg.title: AzUrlShortener production Azure architecture
svg.desc: Presentation diagram of the planned production deployment in West US 2. Four Azure Container Apps run redirect, admin, management API, and scheduled-post workloads. They use an existing Azure Table Storage account, new host storage, Azure Container Registry, and workspace-based Application Insights with Log Analytics. The production deployment has not yet been provisioned.
svg.text: Four isolated workloads. Existing link data retained. Managed identity and centralized telemetry.

g.text: TARGET DESIGN · PRODUCTION APPS NOT YET DEPLOYED

Production target in West US 2. The production resource group has no production apps deployed yet; domain/DNS and certificate binding are separate operator steps.
